section.37: The Book of Fighting [The Prohibition of Bloodshed]

37.name_native: The Book of Fighting [The Prohibition of Bloodshed]

hadiths.text: It was narrated from 'Abdur-Rahman bin 'Abdullah, from his father, that:The Messenger of Allah [SAW] said: "Defaming a Muslim is evildoing and fighting him is Kufr
